# SFML 2.5.1

This directory contains the SFML 2.5.1 headers and the x64 static libraries required to build this project with Visual Studio. The project file references these files through paths relative to the repository, so a separate SFML installation is not required.

SFML is distributed under the zlib/libpng license. See `LICENSE.md` in this directory. The upstream project is available at <https://www.sfml-dev.org/>.
